description: Calculates the court fee prescribed for a DRT original application, a SARFAESI Section 17 securitisation application, or a DRAT appeal, from the amount of debt, citing the rule that prescribes it. For a DRAT appeal it also states the appeal period and the statutory pre-deposit. Use when someone asks what it costs to file before the DRT or DRAT.

amount_inr.description: Amount of debt in rupees, e.g. 25000000 for ₹2.5 crore. Original application: the total claim. SARFAESI application: the debt claimed in the measure challenged. DRAT appeal: the debt due under the order appealed against.

applicant.description: SARFAESI application only: filed by the borrower, or by another aggrieved person. If omitted, both fees are shown.

name: calculate_tribunal_fee
title: DRT / DRAT fee calculator
